name: AVANGAAD
recent: Avangaad 近期出现股权与人事变动：Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn 成为单一最大股东，Johor Corporation、Sindora 和 Kulim 退出；同时两名兄弟 Nazir 与 Mubarak 因 MACC 调查被安排 garden leave。公司最新季度净利大幅增长。
notable: Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn 成为公司单一最大股东，Johor Corporation、Sindora 和 Kulim 退出。
Nazir 与 Mubarak 因 MACC 调查被安排 garden leave。
公司公布截至2026年6月30日季度业绩，净利同比增长。
risks: Nazir 与 Mubarak 因 MACC 调查被安排 garden leave。
Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn 在闭门期内有交易意向。
earnings: 2026年6月30日季度营收为3276.8万令吉，环比增长4.8%，同比增长1.5%；净利为1048万令吉，环比增长106.4%，同比增长73.9%；净利率从16.2%升至32.0%。

recent_en: Avangaad has seen shareholding and management changes: Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn became the single largest shareholder as Johor Corporation, Sindora and Kulim exited; meanwhile, brothers Nazir and Mubarak were placed on garden leave amid an MACC probe. The company's latest quarterly net profit rose sharply.
notable_en: Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn became the company's single largest shareholder as Johor Corporation, Sindora and Kulim exited.
Nazir and Mubarak were placed on garden leave amid an MACC probe.
The company announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with net profit rising year-on-year.
risks_en: Nazir and Mubarak were placed on garden leave amid an MACC probe.
Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn has an intention to deal during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR32.768 million, up 4.8% QoQ and 1.5% YoY; net income was MYR10.48 million, up 106.4% QoQ and 73.9% YoY; net margin rose from 16.2% to 32.0%.
